title: herdr seat configuration
description: Every tunable the seat scripts read (SPEC-04). No script carries its own default; a missing key is a hard error. COQ_HERDR_CONFIG points at another file (tests), COQ_HERDR_SESSION and COQ_STATE override session and state_dir.

session.description: herdr session name every seat lives in; a tier or a test names its own

workspace_label.description: workspace found by label, never by id (ids change on restart)

prompt_regex.description: shell prompt a pane must show before anything is typed into it

retire_poll_seconds.description: how long retire.sh waits for the agent to leave after /exit before it escalates

nudge_wait_seconds.description: WO-20261011-dc0d: how long seat.sh watches a freshly briefed claude seat for the compaction-guard ack line before it logs no ack and moves on (not an error)

nudge_settle_seconds.description: WO-20261011-dc0d: after the ack, how long seat.sh polls agent_status for a stable idle; idle sends the one continue prompt, still working at the end sends none

session_wait_seconds.description: WO-20261012-ee9c: how long seat.sh waits after a claude start for the pane's process to have a session file before it leaves claude_session null (guardwatch.sh fills it on a later tick)

claude_sessions_dir.description: WO-20261012-ee9c: where Claude Code writes <pid>.json (sessionId) for each running session; a pane's claude pid names the file. Leading ~ is expanded

guard_watch_interval_seconds.description: WO-20261012-ee9c: seconds between ticks of herdr/bin/guardwatch.sh --watch, the process in monitor slot 1.1.2

max_agents.description: system-wide cap on live seats; over it seat.sh posts 429 and builds nothing

bringup_gate.description: DEC-system-before-agents: a non-monitor seat is refused while the monitor seat is down

require_guard.description: a seat is refused when compaction-guard is not on PATH (RSK-compaction-sensor); tests set false

monitor_seat.description: name of the monitor seat the gate looks for

health_url.description: null until WO-20261010-539f stands the bus up; bringup.sh then requires a 200

slot.description: the reserved monitors slot (herdr/config/monitors.json name) that runs the route runner; recover.sh restarts it through monitors.sh take

status.description: command whose exit 0 means the belt file is fresh; ${repo} is the checkout. The definition of stale stays in factory/config/runner.json

settle_seconds.description: how long recover.sh --apply waits for a fresh belt after restarting the runner

break_glass.description: DEC-break-glass-one-time: the owner-authorised, one-command bypass of seat.sh --break-glass

ttl_seconds.description: how long a break glass may last before seat.sh restores the role settings; under one hour, never a session or a day

hook_pre_timeout_seconds.description: timeout Claude Code gives the PreToolUse guard hook of a break glass (break-glass-guard.sh pre); it only reads a file and takes a mkdir

hook_post_timeout_seconds.description: timeout Claude Code gives the PostToolUse guard hook of a break glass (break-glass-guard.sh post); it writes the 201 record and runs seat.sh --break-glass-restore, so it gets longer

bearings_tier.description: the bearings tier whose answers.jsonl holds the owner answer

halt_flag.description: recover.sh changes nothing while this file exists; ${state_dir} is state_dir. Only the owner or the monitor seat removes it.

monitor_task.description: the task text bringup.sh hands the monitor seat (door 2 of seat.sh)

watches.description: turnwatch.sh and recwatch.sh (WO-20261012-b800): the agent they prompt and how often they look

architect_agent.description: herdr agent name that receives a TURN or REC prompt

supervisor.description: supervisor.sh (WO-20261012-b800): one tick brings herdr, podman, the panes, the belt, bearings and the seats back

step_timeout_seconds.description: every step of a tick is killed after this long, so a hung command never holds the next tick

herdr_unit.description: systemd user unit that owns the herdr server; empty means the supervisor never starts herdr (the suite, where the world owns it)

podman.description: check podman ps and run podman system migrate when its pause process is gone (backlog 60l24)

grace_seconds.description: a seat's claude must have been gone this long, on two ticks, before it is re-seated

max_per_window.description: re-seats of one seat inside window_seconds before the supervisor stops and says so

down_lock_seconds.description: a seat.sh --down younger than this is still in progress and its seat is left alone

up_seconds.description: a seat record younger than this is still being brought up by seat.sh and is not judged

timeouts.description: every bound supervisor.sh puts on a command it runs (WO-20261012-b800 review fix, record 20261012T160316Z-422-19hjw)

herdr_kill_after_seconds.description: after a herdr call's timeout, how long before it is killed outright

step_kill_after_seconds.description: after a step's timeout, how long before it is killed outright

herdr_list_seconds.description: herdr workspace list and pane list

herdr_probe_seconds.description: each probe while waiting for the herdr unit to answer

herdr_query_seconds.description: herdr agent get and pane process-info

systemctl_seconds.description: systemctl --user start of the herdr unit
